name: tdd-guard
description: Limits which paths each TDD subagent type may write, and reports test files a guarded agent changed through the shell

rules.title: Paths each subagent type may write
rules.description: type=glob,glob entries separated by ';'. +glob: the type may write only paths matching one of its + globs. -glob: the type may not write a path matching a - glob, and a run of it is checked afterwards for changed files under those globs. Globs are relative to the project root; * is one path segment, ** any depth. A type with no entry is not guarded. Empty: nothing is guarded.
